items.title: Scott Yanow interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 22, 2021
items.q: someone who has just so many innovations in their career like Duke Ellington, you’d call them geniuses

ctx.x: Do you have an opinion about what I think is sometimes an overused word and that is the term “genius.” What makes a person or an artist rise to the level of a genius?

I don’t really know. You know that word is definitely overused. I mean you could be a genius in one area, a musical genius, and not necessarily be smart in other aspects of your life. I think if someone comes up with a completely new way of playing jazz, like Charlie Parker or someone who has just so many innovations in their career like Duke Ellington, you’d call them geniuses. But if someone plays their instrument well and they have a nice sound you know genius is kind of overused.
Do you have a short list of your favorite jazz artists?
